* [[publicVariableServer]] (run on client)
* [[publicVariableClient]] (run on server)

Publishes the variable (name as [[String]]) to the server only.
Useful when you want to synchronise a variable with the server but not any other clients. - {{Link|link= http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?136494-ARMA-2-OA-beta-build-94209-(1-60-MP-compatible-build-post-1-60-release)&p=2179795&viewfull=1#post2179795|text= Rocket}}
